trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no extra task behind it and no online requirement: PowerPyx confirms all 55 trophies are offline and single-player, and one playthrough is enough. Follow the three roadmap stages in this guide and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. Just play the story and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It unlocks as the story moves into Chapter 2, so there is nothing to do for it beyond playing the main missions through.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It unlocks when the first main mission of Chapter 3 begins, so it cannot be missed by playing the story normally.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It unlocks once the first missions of Chapter 4 are underway. Keep playing the main story and it arrives on its own.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: A story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the final main mission of that chapter, Starting From Zero. Nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: The last story trophy, for finishing the final mission. Once the credits roll you return to the open world, so every cleanup trophy stays available after this one pops.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks during the mission itself, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks as you play through that mission, so there is nothing extra to prepare.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It unlocks during the mission, so just play the story and it comes to you.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It unlocks as the mission plays out, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks during the mission, so there is nothing to set up in advance.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: A story trophy for the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks during the mission, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, for the 100% Completion Checklist. The checklist itself only appears after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but anything you do during the story already counts toward it. The thresholds are forgiving: PowerPyx puts it near 60% of true completion. You need any 100 optional missions, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, and any 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and most of it falls out of the other trophies, so leave this for stage 2 and watch the counter climb.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps with a parachute, and you can mix them freely. PowerPyx calls flying under bridges the quickest kind. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this one.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. You can see the nine under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, with a count beside each. Most of them happen on their own while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so check what is left late in the run and pick up the stragglers from the map's Activities filter.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. The golds are not too hard, according to PowerPyx, and the 100% checklist wants the same 42, so this trophy and the checklist move together. PowerPyx publishes a guide to all 12 range locations and all 42 gold medals — follow that page range by range.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 drone race locations — 42 races in total across those spots, per PowerPyx. You only need one win per location, not every race. The 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy comes naturally on the way there.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations, so there is plenty of choice — pick the short ones you are comfortable with and repeat until you have 20 distinct wins. The 100% checklist asks for 30 wins, so keep racing past this trophy.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline. Some time after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his quests from there and the trophy pops when you beat him in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck sits at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it, so pick whichever you enjoy most.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It opens in Chapter 3 when Andy calls while you are playing as Lucia, then texts her home address in Belville. Complete her five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Every quest stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's optional questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams, and he shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving at shipwrecks: find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back to him. There are 7 shipwrecks in total across his sets, and you can track them under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a stretch of Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands — but only certain questlines count. PowerPyx confirms Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street races) and Pilot Pete (the delivery runs) count, while the questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Every stranger strand stays available after the story, and you can watch the count on the trophy tracker in the trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage — the green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Track them under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on his list, then drive it back in good condition for a better payout. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is only available as Jason. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, when purple markers appear for the Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Go to the labs and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter; once enough are gone, Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations in Leonida. You can meditate as both Jason and Lucia at the same spot, which counts twice toward the total. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation can only be done in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That spot becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. It is still unconfirmed whether that first meditation is required for the trophy, but PowerPyx's author earned it after doing it, so do it to be safe.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is exclusive to Jason. It opens some time after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animal he requests and bring it back to him. His first quest also hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still unconfirmed, per PowerPyx — follow Bret's requests and it will come. The questline stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx lists 18 card set locations in total, so there is plenty of choice — pick the sets whose cards sit closest together and work through them with a location guide. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting past this trophy.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding Up and then R1 while looking at them. PowerPyx breaks the pool down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus the No Flusher tags — more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do. Scan whatever you pass while playing and this one fills up on its own; the 100% checklist wants the same 100.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. You can view and track them under Progress, then Challenges, with a checkmark showing which are done. Most of them complete naturally while you work on the other trophies, so leave this for late in the run and then pick the easiest ones that remain. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can play as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape in a fast sports motorcycle; PowerPyx suggests driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — do not lose the flashing wanted level between them. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items, call your partner, then loot three robbery targets in a row. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not, hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app on your phone — hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan. Scanning is enough; you never need to drive them. The easiest method is to stand on a busy road and scan the traffic going past. GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this trophy comes early on the way there. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food, drinks, or Adrenaline, and wear body armor so you can step out of cover. Line up five enemies — gang members at gang operations work; PowerPyx notes police, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count — and drop them quickly with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556. Your focus level grows as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing, so this gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, Vice City International Airport — the planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest is the one at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane by the boarding bridge, use the stairs and the door to get inside, then go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off. Fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops, slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks stand at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy military response, so go in ready for a fight.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies on the map with green icons. Enter through the back door using the Snap Gun instead of kicking it in, find the note with the safe code in the back room, and empty the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently once unlocked.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): it teaches the method — tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then slip in while the vault is open and rob it with your partner, handing off a bag with Right. After that mission, Yasmani sells tips about security vans for $10,000, marking them with purple icons. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so this trophy pops on the way.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easy way is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which unlocks bank vault robberies: robbing a large bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank. You can also do it earlier by blocking an armored truck driving near a bank, planting a sticky bomb on its back door and blowing it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops once you escape the red heat radius, so plan your getaway first.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map by visiting all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the whole map is visible. PowerPyx publishes a guide to unfogging the map fast, including the best plane for the job — follow it once you have a plane and this one falls quickly.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically as the story progresses. You can track each gang under Progress, then Gangs, where the count of robbed operations shows beside it. The 100% checklist wants all 39, so this trophy pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: From the official description alone, this trophy is about having a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — but no steps have been verified in the game yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known at launch, so treat any specific bar or spot as unconfirmed until a published guide pins it down. Check the source link for updates once players find the trigger.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight out through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You can only take the car after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the Banshee, drive forward through the glass, and the trophy pops a moment later once you are out on the street. It only works with this blue Banshee, not any other car.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You can do it during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and if you miss an item you can come back later once the robbery icon respawns, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two characters. Check each one's strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength. Buy a fitness club membership and always train together — call your partner over, and while you work out with one character the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City under Map, then Activities.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Your profile shifts between Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing) and Irredeemable — and Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid going on a rampage. Most players earn this passively while working on the other trophies, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.guide: No steps have been verified in the game yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known at launch, and only notes it is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — that is a guess, not a confirmed method. From the official description, 'second time's the charm' suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, but do not chase a specific spot until a published guide confirms it. Check the source link for updates.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No steps have been verified in the game yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known at launch, and only notes it is believed to be tied to a UFO questline somewhere in Leonida — that is a guess, not a confirmed method. The description points to witnessing something strange, so keep an eye out for odd events while exploring, and check the source link for updates once players pin the trigger down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No steps have been verified in the game yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known at launch, and only notes it is believed to involve kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — that is a guess, not a confirmed method. The name and description point to knocking someone over with a melee attack from a moving bike, but do not grind a specific move until a published guide confirms it. Check the source link for updates.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder the bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most, per PowerPyx. The $250,000 builds up across robberies, so you never need to carry it all at once, and a single bank vault can pay up to $205,000. It comes naturally while doing the robberies for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. The fastest way is to buy the expensive things: guns, car mods and tattoos. PowerPyx counts 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, so spend wherever you are and the total climbs. It comes naturally if you gear up properly for the other trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garage properties, which cost about $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone — buy the garages through that app. The 4 story-related garages do not count toward this trophy. Robberies are the quickest way to raise the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.label: PSNProfiles — trophy list with PSN targets

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. You need enough garages first, since each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles — see Little Boxes. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
